scope: The note editor (typed + handwriting tabs), the handwriting textarea, the writing-check capability detector, autosave (keyboard input_mode only), the I27 story test. Out of scope: contenteditable/Tiptap/Slate/ProseMirror/Lexical, any model call on the save path (I28), the ink pad (024).

acceptance_criteria.text: BLOCKED: the check runs once per device — detector built, but no per-device result can be recorded without a real device pass (Q7/Q9).
PARTIAL: typing a paragraph yields one pending update via keyboard input_mode; stylus_os value withheld pending C6 sign-off.
BLOCKED: requires three real pilot users on real tablets in Indonesian (Q7/Q8/Q9) — cannot be performed by an agent.
The story test fails if a Stage overlaps the open sheet.

open_questions: Q7 (unanswered: run the 45-minute device test) — blocks g4, g6, and the task Gate. Cannot be resolved by an agent; requires a human running the test on real hardware.
Q8 (unanswered: the real tablet mix) — blocks g6 in the same way.
Q9 (unanswered: assume a pen; verify) — blocks g4, g6 in the same way.

C6 (awaiting human sign-off: input_mode three-value enum) — blocks the stylus_os branch of g5; keyboard branch proceeds using the existing input_mode field shape from 02-database-architecture.md §8.1 without inventing the stylus_os value.
risks: Scribble does not list Bahasa Indonesia (v2 §3.4) — the single biggest risk in handwriting, unresolved until g6 runs.
A lazily mounted textarea misses the pen-down (v2 §3.3 #4) — mitigated by mounting the textarea eagerly (not lazily) inside the handwriting tab.
An LLM call on the save path (I28) — mitigated by keeping the note-editor save path a direct repository write, same shape as insertHighlight() in task 010.
